name: Datasheets for Datasets
citation: Gebru T, Morgenstern J, Vecchione B, Wortman Vaughan J, Wallach H, Daume III H, Crawford K. Datasheets for Datasets. Commun ACM 2021;64(12):86-92, doi:10.1145/3458723; also arXiv:1803.09010 (https://arxiv.org/abs/1803.09010). The paper lists its questions as unnumbered bullets in seven sections (motivation, composition, collection process, preprocessing/cleaning/labeling, uses, distribution, maintenance). Items 1-50 follow them one per question in the paper's order; each section's closing 'any other comments' bullet is left out. Questions about people apply only when the dataset relates to people.

items.topic: Motivation: purpose, intended task and gap
items.question: Does the paper say why the dataset was created, for which task, and which gap it fills?

items.topic: Motivation: creators and the entity behind them
items.question: Does it name who created the dataset (team, group) and on behalf of which organisation?
Does it say who funded the dataset's creation, naming the grant and grantor where there is one?
Is it clear what each instance stands for (documents, images, people, places...) and whether there are several instance types?
Is the total number of instances given, per type where there are several?

items.topic: Composition: complete set or sample, representativeness
items.question: Does it say whether the data hold every possible instance or a sample, and how the sample relates to the larger set?
Is what each instance consists of described (raw data such as text or images, or derived features)?
Does it say whether instances carry a label or target, and describe it?
Is information missing from any instance reported, with the reason (unavailable, removed...)?
Are links between instances (users, ratings, citations...) made explicit and described?
Are recommended splits (training, validation, test) given, with the reasoning behind them?
Are known errors, sources of noise or duplicated records in the data described?
If the data rely on external resources, does it say whether they stay available, are archived, and carry restrictions?
Does it say whether the data hold confidential material (legally privileged, doctor-patient, private communications)?
Does it say whether any content could offend, threaten or distress someone viewing it, and why?
If the data relate to people, are subpopulations (age, gender...) identified, how, and with what distribution?
If the data relate to people, can individuals be identified, directly or combined with other data, and how?
If the data relate to people, do they reveal sensitive attributes (health, ethnicity, beliefs, finances, location...)?

items.topic: Collection process: how instance data were acquired
items.question: Is it said whether the data were observed, reported by subjects or inferred, and how inferred data were checked?

items.topic: Collection process: mechanisms and their validation
items.question: Are the instruments, software or procedures used to collect the data described, and how they were validated?
If the data are a sample, is the sampling strategy (random, stratified, probabilistic weights...) stated?

items.topic: Collection process: who collected, how paid
items.question: Does it say who took part in collecting the data (staff, crowdworkers...) and how they were compensated?
Is the period of collection given, and does it say whether it matches the period the data describe?
Were ethical review processes (e.g. an institutional review board) carried out, and are their outcome and documents reported?

items.topic: Collection process: direct or third-party source
items.question: If the data relate to people, were they obtained from the individuals directly or through third parties?
If the data relate to people, were they told about the collection, and how?
If the data relate to people, did they consent to collection and use, and how was consent asked and recorded?
If consent was obtained, can people withdraw it later or for specific uses, and how?

items.topic: Collection process: impact analysis on subjects
items.question: If the data relate to people, was an analysis of the impact on data subjects (e.g. data protection) carried out and reported?
Is any preprocessing, cleaning or labeling (discretizing, tokenizing, removing instances, imputing...) described?
Was the raw data kept alongside the processed data, and where can it be reached?
Is the software used to preprocess, clean or label the data available, and where?

items.topic: Uses: tasks already done with the data
items.question: Does it say whether the dataset has already been used, and for which tasks?

items.topic: Uses: registry of papers and systems using it
items.question: Is there a place that links to work using the dataset, and is it given?

items.topic: Uses: other tasks it could serve
items.question: Does it suggest other tasks the dataset could be used for?

items.topic: Uses: features that could bias future uses
items.question: Does it warn about features of composition, collection or processing that could lead to unfair treatment or other harm, and how to mitigate it?

items.topic: Uses: tasks it should not be used for
items.question: Does it name tasks for which the dataset should not be used?
Does it say whether the dataset will be shared with third parties outside the creating organisation?
Does it say how the data are distributed (repository, API, archive) and give a persistent identifier such as a DOI?
Does it say when the dataset is or will be released?

items.topic: Distribution: licence and terms of use
items.question: Is the copyright or other licence, or the terms of use, stated with a link or copy and any fees?
Have third parties imposed intellectual-property or other restrictions on the data, and are they described?
Do export controls or other regulatory restrictions apply to the dataset or its instances, and are they described?

items.topic: Maintenance: who hosts and maintains it
items.question: Does it say who will support, host and maintain the dataset?

items.topic: Maintenance: how to contact the curator
items.question: Is a way to contact the owner or curator of the dataset given?
Is there an erratum, and where can it be found?
Will the dataset be updated (corrections, additions, removals), by whom, how often, and how will users hear of it?

items.topic: Maintenance: retention limits for personal data
items.question: If the data relate to people, are limits on how long their data are kept stated and enforced?
Will older versions stay available and maintained, and how will their obsolescence be communicated?
Can others extend or contribute to the dataset, and are contributions validated and passed on to users?
